name: The Invisible Why — Weekly Analytics Report

parameters.content:
## Weekly Analytics Import
Pulls last 7 days of channel performance from the YouTube Analytics API, saves a raw JSON snapshot plus an appended CSV summary row under analytics/, and posts a short summary to Slack.

Requires the same YouTube OAuth2 credential used for uploads (needs the youtube.readonly / yt-analytics.readonly scopes in addition to youtube.upload) and SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL. See docs/SETUP.md.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ text: 'Invisible Why — week ending ' + $json.weekEnding + ': ' + $json.views + ' views, ' + Math.round($json.minutesWatched/60) + ' hours watched, +' + $json.subsGained + ' subscribers.' }) }}
